gbifID.description: Globally unique identifier for each occurrence record.

datasetKey.description: Uniform dataset identifier linking all records to the same occurrence dataset.

occurrenceID.description: Unique iNaturalist observation URL linking each record to its source entry.

kingdom.description: Taxonomic kingdom designation for each occurrence, consistently Plantae.

phylum.description: Taxonomic phylum classification for each occurrence, consistently Tracheophyta.

class.description: Plant taxonomic class for each occurrence, consistently Magnoliopsida.

order.description: Taxonomic order of the plant, consistently Lamiales.

family.description: Family classification of the species, uniformly Plantaginaceae.

genus.description: Genus of the recorded plant species, consistently Keckiella.

species.description: Scientific name of the recorded plant species.

infraspecificEpithet.description: Taxonomic rank below species identifying subspecies or variety.

taxonRank.description: Taxonomic rank of the record, specifying either species or variety.

scientificName.description: Taxonomic designation of the observed Keckiella breviflora, including species and variety names.

verbatimScientificName.description: Original recorded scientific name of the plant, including subspecies and variety designations.

verbatimScientificNameAuthorship.description: Original author citation for the scientific name, as recorded in source data.

countryCode.description: Country code for all records, using ISO two‑letter format (US).

locality.description: Locality information is missing for all records.

stateProvince.description: Recorded state or province of occurrence, limited to California and Nevada.

occurrenceStatus.description: Occurrence status confirming species presence at each recorded location.

individualCount.description: Number of individual plants observed per occurrence record.

publishingOrgKey.description: Publishing organization identifier, identical UUID across all occurrence records.

decimalLatitude.description: Geographic latitude in decimal degrees for each occurrence record.

decimalLongitude.description: Geographic longitude of observation in decimal degrees, ranging from western United States.

coordinateUncertaintyInMeters.description: Spatial uncertainty of occurrence coordinates measured in meters.

coordinatePrecision.description: Precision of location coordinates is missing for every record.

elevation.description: Elevation (meters above sea level) is missing for all records.

elevationAccuracy.description: No elevation accuracy measurements recorded for any occurrence.

depth.description: Depth field is missing for all records.

depthAccuracy.description: Depth accuracy measurement is unavailable for all records.

eventDate.description: Date and time of each Keckiella breviflora occurrence record.

day.description: Day of month when the observation was recorded.

month.description: Month of observation, ranging from January (1) to December (12).

year.description: Observation year of each Keckiella breviflora record, ranging from 2006 to 2026.

taxonKey.description: Taxonomic identifier for each record linking to the species taxonomy database.

speciesKey.description: Unique identifier for the Keckiella breviflora taxon across all occurrence records.

basisOfRecord.description: Record type indicating observation was made by a human observer.

institutionCode.description: Source institution identifier for occurrence records, consistently iNaturalist.

collectionCode.description: Collection type is observations for all records.

catalogNumber.description: Unique numeric identifier assigned to each Keckiella breviflora occurrence record.

recordNumber.description: No data recorded for this field.

identifiedBy.description: Names or usernames of individuals who recorded the Keckiella breviflora observation.

dateIdentified.description: Date and time when the occurrence was identified.

license.description: License type for the occurrence record, expressed as Creative Commons identifiers.

rightsHolder.description: Name of individual or organization holding copyright for each occurrence record.

recordedBy.description: Observer names documenting each Keckiella breviflora occurrence record.

typeStatus.description: No type status information is recorded for any occurrence.

establishmentMeans.description: Establishment means data missing for all records.

lastInterpreted.description: Last interpretation timestamp of the occurrence record.

mediaType.description: Media format recorded for each occurrence entry.

issue.description: Data quality flags noting coordinate rounding, continent derivation, or missing taxon identifier.

keckiella_breviflora.description: Keckiella breviflora occurrence records (2006‑2026) with taxonomy, coordinates, dates, observers, and media metadata.

description: Records of Keckiella breviflora occurrences from 2006 to 2026 for biodiversity monitoring.
